findings.description: This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption setting may be stored without customer-managed or bucket-default encryption controls.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. The private ACL does not provide encryption for ledger data stored in the bucket.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not ensure encryption of stored model artifacts.
This bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning does not protect the confidentiality of runbook content at rest.

This object is uploaded to a bucket with no default encryption and does not set a server-side encryption option itself, so the vendor roster is not assured to be encrypted at rest by this configuration.
